newsitem.title: USA: RMH comfortable with Q4, 1996 estimates.
newsitem.headline: RMH comfortable with Q4, 1996 estimates.

text.p: RHM Teleservices Inc said on Friday it was comfortable with analysts estimates for both the fourth quarter and fiscal 1996.
The First Call mean earnings estimate for the fourth quarter ending September 30 was $0.06 per share and the fiscal 1996 mean estimate was $0.31 per share.
"The fundamentals of the company and the industry dynamics remain strong and we continue to be optimistic with regard to the future," said Raymond Hansell, chief executive officer.
The inbound and outbound teleservices provider also said it opened its ninth call center in Harrisburg, Pa.
